_comment: Template for ops/live-gate.json. Copy, fill with REAL measured results, and commit as an audit record. Every field is checked by core/gate.py; a missing or malformed field leaves live mode locked. See .claude/skills/tradecc-paper-validation/references/gate-checklist.md for how to produce each value.
_trade_count_note: Closed round trips over the paper period. Must be >= core.performance.MIN_POOLED_TRADES (12), the same floor the walk-forward protocol uses. Positive expectancy on fewer trades is not distinguishable from luck — the sweep produced '+$0.47 on 3 trades'.
_validated_fingerprint_note: Binds this approval to the exact strategy and limits it was granted against, so a gate approved for one configuration cannot unlock a different one. Generate with the command in gate-checklist.md and paste the result verbatim. The digests below are placeholders and WILL fail until regenerated against your own config.
_validated_fingerprint_covers: strategy (name, params, token_mints); risk (all fields); costs (all fields); execution_assumptions (backtest.price_impact_pct and backtest.execution_slippage_pct — the adverse-price assumptions the expectancy figure was computed under).
_validated_fingerprint_excludes: state_dir, gate_file, data.cache_dir, paper.poll_seconds. These are locations and polling cadence: they do not change what was validated, so moving the bot to another machine or retuning the poll interval must not invalidate an approval. A gate that fails for reasons unrelated to the evidence gets worked around, which is worse than one that never fires.
